name: Manchester University
academic_ranking: Private nonprofit liberal arts university in North Manchester, IN, with 70+ undergraduate programs and graduate/professional/doctoral offerings (including a Doctor of Pharmacy, MBA, and a distinctive Peace Studies major). Emphasizes personalized, mentor-driven education. Students come from 21 states and 9 countries. No formal third-party ranking listed on official pages.
financial_aid: Full-time undergraduate tuition is $36,484 for 2026-2027; full list price (tuition, housing, fees) is $51,714. School reports average annual cost after aid of $19,376, reflecting ~$25,058 in average MU scholarships/grants plus ~$7,280 in average federal/state grants. FAFSA required (school code 001820). Tuition guarantee held over four years.
facilities_notes: Softball plays home games at the MU Softball Field on the North Manchester campus.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference (HCAC); the university has earned HCAC conference championships and All-American honors across its athletics programs.
notes: As an NCAA Division III institution, Manchester does not offer athletic scholarships (aid is academic/need-based only); scholarship_count set to null. Data gathered from muspartans.com softball staff and roster pages and manchester.edu on 2026-07. Roster size reflects 24 listed players (plus 1 student manager not counted).
